how: Treetops Adventure St Ives runs self-guided tree ropes courses 1-15 m above ground with swinging bridges and cargo nets, graded from beginner to expert; the park is about 30 minutes from the CBD.
Ziplines are part of the tree ropes courses at Treetops Adventure St Ives (Showgrounds, Mona Vale Rd).
iFLY Sydney wind tunnel next to Penrith Panthers offers first-time flights with training and gear, ages 3 and up.
Penrith Whitewater Stadium, an artificial whitewater course at Penrith Lakes, offers large rubber raft rides and kayaking; natural-river rafting is far away.
No caves open for adventure caving in the metro area; the nearest is Jenolan Caves, about 175 km west (roughly 3 hours by road), which offers abseiling and adventure cave tours.
No snow fields near Sydney; the nearest resorts are Thredbo and Perisher in the Snowy Mountains, about 500 km south (roughly 6 hours by road, or a flight to Cooma).
No glaciers in mainland Australia; the nearest guided glacier walks are at Franz Josef, New Zealand (heli-hikes), a trans-Tasman flight plus onward travel of most of a day.
No natural hot springs in the Sydney area; the nearest are the artesian hot spring baths at Moree, about 628 km north-west (roughly 8 hours by road or a short flight).
No volcanoes within reach of Sydney; volcano boarding is done at Cerro Negro (Nicaragua) and Mount Yasur (Vanuatu, the closest, a flight of several hours).
Bullfighting is not practised in Australia (illegal in most countries); the nearest traditions are in Spain, Portugal, southern France and Latin America, a full day or more of travel away.
No wild-animal safari in the Sydney area; the nearest open-range experience is Taronga Western Plains Zoo in Dubbo, about 400 km west (roughly 5 hours by road), and true safaris are in Africa.
No large dunes or desert near Sydney; the nearest big mobile dunes are at Stockton Bight near Newcastle, roughly 2.5 hours north by road.
No canyons within the metro area; the nearest canyoning is in the Blue Mountains, roughly 100 km west (about 2 hours by road).
